gizmo.title: Rapu kupu
gizmo.description: He mātiti pū me ngā kupu huna. Ka pātō ngā ākonga i te pū tuatahi me te pū whakamutunga o ia kupu. Ka whakaharatau i te kite i te tuhi o tētahi kupu, kaua ko tōna tikanga.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te mea e tonoa ana ngā ākonga kia kimihia, ka whakaaturia ki te pane.

configure.title: Ngā kupu
configure.description: Ngā kupu hei huna. Ka waiho ngā mokowā me ngā tohutuhi ki waho o te mātiti. Ko ngā kupu kāore e uru ka whakarārangitia i a koe e whakatika ana, ā, ka waiho ki waho mō ngā ākonga.

advanced.title: Rahi mātiti
advanced.description: Ngā pū mō ia taha, 4 ki te 16. Waiho kia wātea kia uru te kupu roa rawa (tae atu ki te 12). Ki te nui ake i te 12 ka panuku whakatahā i te waea.

advanced.title: Ngā kupu hauroki
advanced.description: Hunaia hoki ngā kupu ā-hauroki. He uaua ake.

advanced.title: Ngā kupu whakamuri
advanced.description: Hunaia hoki ngā kupu kua tuhia whakamuri. He uaua ake.

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: He tae kōwhiri mō te maramara pane, te pū tuatahi kua kōwhiria me te pātene.
